summary: Retest after fixes confirms BOTH critical regressions are resolved. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ai_bot_http.py = 11/12 PASS. POST /api/conversations/{id}/summary/regenerate now returns 200 with {summary: string} and POST /api/conversations/{id}/bot/suggest-reply returns 200 with {draft, confidence, intent}. No more LlmChat.with_max_tokens AttributeError in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (now calls .with_params(...) correctly). Frontend: Configuracion /Bot IA tab — ctxmax=2 click on Guardar surfaces red Spanish toast 'Los mensajes de contexto deben estar entre 3 y 50' and NO PATCH is fired (verified via response listener); restoring ctxmax=12 fires PATCH 200 with 'Cambios guardados' toast; modifying threshold and saving also fires PATCH 200 with 'Cambios guardados' toast. Inbox AI panel — bot-panel renders, bot-suggest-button click yields 200 response and bot-suggestion-textarea populated (draft_len=132, confidence=0.8, intent='seguimiento_pedido'); bot-suggestion-use copies the draft verbatim into message-input; bot-suggestion-discard removes the textarea. Regression endpoints GET /api/conversations and GET /api/conversations/{id} also return 200. The only remaining backend failure (POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages 500 ObjectId) is the pre-existing serialization bug explicitly marked OUT OF SCOPE by the task.

minor.issue: (OUT OF SCOPE per task) Still returns 500 because msg_doc mutated by Motor.insert_one keeps ObjectId _id. Documented in iteration_3 and explicitly excluded from this retest.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/ai/llm.py now wraps any non-LLMUnavailable Exception into LLMUnavailable (broad except after the LlmChat builder). Good defensive programming — pipeline.regenerate_summary / suggest_reply already handle LLMUnavailable gracefully so the endpoints stay 200 even if the SDK shape changes again.

Note: call_llm_json now returns a tuple (dict, raw_str) — verify all callers (pipeline.py) destructure it accordingly. From the green tests this appears correct, but worth a code-grep before next release.

Configuracion BotIATab: 'Guardar cambios' button is correctly disabled when form is pristine (no changes) — small UX gotcha for testing (sending the same value won't trigger a PATCH). Could surface a tooltip 'No hay cambios' for clarity.
server.py still ~2600 lines — split into routers/* recommended (carry-over from iteration_3).
Pre-existing send_message ObjectId leak remains and was explicitly marked out of scope; should be fixed in a follow-up because every POST /messages from the UI will 500.
